author: Tech_Bender
body: Even if he doesn't the fact that he took the time to do this in the first place is still great and very much appreciated. It's amazing that a game Dev would actually take the time to listen to their fan base and try to make the game work for them rather than just try to take their money. Mobile games have become toxic in this regard. I wish more developers would use this model instead.
